model: Official DINOv2 ViT-S/14 with four registers, not fine-tuned
frame_selection: Sorted RGB frames at floor(N/3) and floor(2N/3); fixed before download, never selected by matcher success.
references: Same nine baseline reference crops. RGB-only foreground estimation; observation labels, poses and masks are excluded from inference.
case_design: Six same-category and six cyclic cross-category paired cases. First-view and both-view conditions.
primary_metric: One highest-ranked review proposal per query, bbox IoU>=0.30 against the visible annotation bbox in the selected view. Also report IoU>=0.50, absent-target proposals, center-in-mask and unresolved outputs.
support_policy: Learned visual-similarity suggestions are not verified identity. Baseline strong acceptance tiers and controller remain unchanged.
development_selection: Three growth widths examined on the reused 15 development RGBs: 0.10, 0.20, 0.15. Selected 0.15. Records retained. No threshold changes after this freeze.
limitation: Held out from this project's tuning only, not a claim of absence from foundation-model pretraining. Same physical objects and related clip frames; not independent identity trials or representative accuracy.
